title: XOR Operation in an Arithmetic Array
description: Given two integers `n` and `start`, consider the array `nums` of length `n` defined by `nums[i] = start + 2 * i` for `0 <= i < n`. Return the bitwise XOR of all elements of `nums`. Because `n` can be as large as `10^9`, compute the result without iterating through all `n` elements.
hints: Every term `start + 2 * i` shares the exact same least significant bit (`start & 1`), while dividing by 2 shifts the sequence into consecutive integers `(start >> 1) + i`.
The prefix XOR `0 ^ 1 ^ ... ^ x` repeats with period 4 (`x`, `1`, `x + 1`, `0` for `x % 4 == 0, 1, 2, 3`), letting you compute any consecutive range XOR in O(1) time.
